translationRepairs: In the intercalary month, on gengxu, supervising secretaries Ai Hong, Lü Chong, and Liu Qian, with Nanjing colleagues Dai Xian and Censor Bo Yanhui and twenty others, were flogged at the palace gate.

In the intercalary month, on gengxu, supervising secretaries Ai Hong, Lü Chong, and Liu Qian, with Nanjing colleagues Dai Xian and Censor Bo Yanhui—twenty-one men in all—were flogged at the palace gate.
等二十一人 gives the total of twenty-one, not twenty others besides those named.

Intercalary month, day gengxu: supervising secretaries Ai Hong, Lü Chong, Liu Qian, and Nanjing supervising secretaries Dai Xian, Censor Bo Yanhui, and twenty others were beaten with the rod below the palace gate.

Intercalary month, day gengxu: supervising secretaries Ai Hong, Lü Chong, Liu Qian, and Nanjing supervising secretaries Dai Xian, Censor Bo Yanhui—twenty-one men in all—were beaten with the rod below the palace gate.
等二十一人 gives the total of twenty-one, not twenty others besides those named.
On bingxu Yang Tinghe, Nanjing vice minister of revenue, entered the Grand Secretariat as Wenyuan grand secretary.
On bingxu Yang Tinghe, Nanjing minister of revenue, entered the Grand Secretariat as Wenyuan grand secretary.
南京戶部尚書 is Minister (尚書), not Vice Minister (侍郎).
Day bingxu: Yang Tinghe, vice minister of revenue at Nanjing, was made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
Day bingxu: Yang Tinghe, minister of revenue at Nanjing, was made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and deliberated on state affairs.
南京戶部尚書 is Minister (尚書), not Vice Minister (侍郎).
In the ninth month, on maoyin, the official registers of retired ministers Yong Tai, Ma Wensheng, Xu Jin, and Liu Daxia were expunged.
In the ninth month, on guimao, the official registers of retired ministers Yong Tai, Ma Wensheng, Xu Jin, and Liu Daxia were expunged.
癸卯 is guimao, not maoyin.
Ninth month, day maoyin: the registers of retired ministers Yong Tai, Ma Wensheng, Xu Jin, and Liu Daxia were struck.
Ninth month, day guimao: the registers of retired ministers Yong Tai, Ma Wensheng, Xu Jin, and Liu Daxia were struck.
癸卯 is guimao, not maoyin.
In the eleventh month of winter, on jiazi, he raided Huamachi and Grand Coordinator Cai Kuan was killed in action.
In the eleventh month of winter, on jiazi, he raided Huamachi and Supreme Commander Cai Kuan was killed in action.
總制尚書 is a minister serving as Supreme Commander (總制), not a Grand Coordinator (巡撫).
Winter, eleventh month, day jiazi: he raided Huamachi; Grand Coordinator Cai Kuan died in battle.
Winter, eleventh month, day jiazi: he raided Huamachi; Supreme Commander Cai Kuan died in battle.
總制尚書 is a minister serving as Supreme Commander (總制), not a Grand Coordinator (巡撫).

On yiyou Jiangxi banditry flared; Right Censor-in-Chief Wang Zhe was sent to inspect southern Gan, and Minister of Punishments Hong Zhong was given overall command on the Sichuan-Shaanxi-Henan-Yunyang front while relieving famine in Huguang.

On yiyou Jiangxi banditry flared; Right Censor-in-Chief Wang Zhe was sent to inspect Nan'an and Ganzhou, and Minister of Punishments Hong Zhong was given overall command on the Sichuan-Shaanxi-Henan-Yunyang front while relieving famine in Huguang.
南、贛 names two prefectures, Nan(an) and Gan(zhou), not "southern Gan".
On bingwu Right Censor-in-Chief Yang Yiqing was recalled to overall command in Ningxia, Yan-sui, Gansu, and Liang, and Earl of Divine Valor Shen Ying was named regional commander to crush Zhu Zhifan.
On bingwu Right Censor-in-Chief Yang Yiqing was recalled to overall command in Ningxia, Yan-sui, Gansu, and Liang, and Earl of Jingyang Shen Ying was named regional commander to crush Zhu Zhifan.
涇陽伯 is the Earl of Jingyang (a place title); 神 is Shen Ying's surname, not "Divine Valor".

Day bingwu: Right Censor-in-Chief Yang Yiqing was raised to overall command of military affairs in Ningxia, Yan-sui, Gansu, and Liang; the Earl of Divine Valor Shen Ying filled the post of regional commander—to suppress Zhifan.

Day bingwu: Right Censor-in-Chief Yang Yiqing was raised to overall command of military affairs in Ningxia, Yan-sui, Gansu, and Liang; the Earl of Jingyang Shen Ying filled the post of regional commander—to suppress Zhifan.
涇陽伯 is the Earl of Jingyang (a place title); 神 is Shen Ying's surname, not "Divine Valor".
In the second month, on bingchen, Zhu Zhifan was executed.
In the second month, on bingshen, Zhu Zhifan was executed.
丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen.
Second month, day bingchen: Zhifan was executed.
Second month, day bingshen: Zhifan was executed.
丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen.
In the eleventh month, on gengxu, the eunuchs Gu Dayong and Zhang Zhong and Baron of Fuxiang Mao Rui led capital armies to join Lu Wan against the bandits.
In the eleventh month, on gengxu, the eunuchs Gu Dayong and Zhang Zhong and Earl of Fuxiang Mao Rui led capital armies to join Lu Wan against the bandits.
伏羌伯: 伯 is the rank of earl, not baron.
Eleventh month, day gengxu: the eunuchs Gu Dayong and Zhang Zhong and Baron of Fuxiang Mao Rui led capital troops to join Lu Wan against the bandits.
Eleventh month, day gengxu: the eunuchs Gu Dayong and Zhang Zhong and Earl of Fuxiang Mao Rui led capital troops to join Lu Wan against the bandits.
伏羌伯: 伯 is the rank of earl, not baron.
In the third month, on xinwei, Vice Regional Commander Shi Yuan was routed in Henan and Assistant Regional Commander Feng Zhen was killed fighting.
In the third month, on xinwei, Vice Regional Commander Shi Yuan was routed in Henan and Assistant Commissioner-in-Chief Feng Zhen was killed fighting.
都督僉事 is Assistant Commissioner-in-Chief of a Chief Military Commission, not an assistant regional commander.
Third month, day xinwei: Vice Regional Commander Shi Yuan was defeated in Henan; Assistant Regional Commander Feng Zhen fought fiercely and died.
Third month, day xinwei: Vice Regional Commander Shi Yuan was defeated in Henan; Assistant Commissioner-in-Chief Feng Zhen fought fiercely and died.
都督僉事 is Assistant Commissioner-in-Chief of a Chief Military Commission, not an assistant regional commander.
The eunuch Zhang Yong directed the campaign, Regional Commander Bai Yu was named overall commander, and capital armies marched out to meet the invader.
The eunuch Zhang Yong directed the campaign, Chief Military Commissioner Bai Yu was named regional commander, and capital armies marched out to meet the invader.
都督 is a Chief Military Commissioner (cf. 左都督 "Left Chief Commander" in s0222); the post he filled, 總兵官, is regional commander.
The eunuch Zhang Yong supervised military affairs; Regional Commander Bai Yu filled the post of commander and led capital camp troops to resist him.
The eunuch Zhang Yong supervised military affairs; Chief Military Commissioner Bai Yu filled the post of regional commander and led capital camp troops to resist him.
都督 is a Chief Military Commissioner (cf. 左都督 "Left Chief Commander" in s0222); the post he filled, 總兵官, is regional commander.
In the eleventh month, on xinyou, Prince of Guishan Dang Hong was stripped to commoner rank and killed himself.
In the eleventh month, on xinyou, Prince of Guishan, Danghu, was stripped to commoner rank and killed himself.
當沍 is the prince's two-character given name (surname Zhu, generation character 當); 沍 is read hu, and splitting it as "Dang Hong" misreads it as a surname plus given name.
In the eleventh month, day xinyou: the Prince of Guishan, Dang Hong, was deposed to commoner status and took his own life.
In the eleventh month, day xinyou: the Prince of Guishan, Danghu, was deposed to commoner status and took his own life.
當沍 is the prince's two-character given name (surname Zhu, generation character 當); 沍 is read hu, and splitting it as "Dang Hong" misreads it as a surname plus given name.
In spring of Zhengde eleven, on yinai of the first month, he performed the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
In spring of Zhengde eleven, on yiwei of the first month, he performed the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
乙未 is yiwei; "yinai" is not a sexagenary term.
In spring of Zhengde year eleven, the first month, day yinai: Heaven and Earth were grandly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
In spring of Zhengde year eleven, the first month, day yiwei: Heaven and Earth were grandly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
乙未 is yiwei; "yinai" is not a sexagenary term.

In the seventh month of autumn, on yinai, the Little Prince hit Baiyang Pass in Ji; Eunuch Zhang Zhong oversaw the campaign, Left Chief Commander Liu Hui served as commander-in-chief, and Eastern and Western Official Hall troops were sent against him.

In the seventh month of autumn, on yiwei, the Little Prince hit Baiyang Pass in Ji; Eunuch Zhang Zhong oversaw the campaign, Left Chief Commander Liu Hui served as commander-in-chief, and Eastern and Western Official Hall troops were sent against him.
乙未 is yiwei; "yinai" is not a sexagenary term.

In autumn, the seventh month, day yinai: the Little Prince raided Baiyang Pass in Ji Prefecture; Eunuch Zhang Zhong supervised military affairs; Left Chief Commander Liu Hui served as overall commander and led the Eastern and Western Official Hall armies to repel him.

In autumn, the seventh month, day yiwei: the Little Prince raided Baiyang Pass in Ji Prefecture; Eunuch Zhang Zhong supervised military affairs; Left Chief Commander Liu Hui served as overall commander and led the Eastern and Western Official Hall armies to repel him.
乙未 is yiwei; "yinai" is not a sexagenary term.
On jiachen more than thirty-four hundred men taken from the palace were enrolled as maritime households.
On jiachen more than thirty-four hundred self-castrated men were enrolled as maritime households.
自宮男子 means men who castrated themselves (hoping for palace service), not men taken or recruited from the palace.
Day jiachen: more than 3,400 men recruited from the palace were registered as maritime households.
Day jiachen: more than 3,400 self-castrated men were registered as maritime households.
自宮男子 means men who castrated themselves (hoping for palace service), not men taken or recruited from the palace.
In the eighth month, day dingsi: Left Censor-in-Chief Peng Ze and the Duke of Cheng, Zhu Fu, led Metropolitan Banner troops to guard the frontier.
In the eighth month, day dingsi: Left Censor-in-Chief Peng Ze and the Duke of Cheng, Zhu Fu, led capital camp troops to guard the frontier.
京營兵 are the Ming capital camp troops; "Banner" is an anachronistic Qing term.
On rewu he returned from Xuanfu.
On renwu he returned from Xuanfu.
壬午 is renwu; "rewu" is a misspelling.
Day rewu: he returned from Xuanfu.
Day renwu: he returned from Xuanfu.
壬午 is renwu; "rewu" is a misspelling.
Rewards for Ying Prefecture were entered on the rolls: more than fifty thousand men received enfeoffment privileges, promotion, or bounty.
Rewards for Ying Prefecture were entered on the rolls: more than fifty thousand men received hereditary (yin) privileges, promotion, or bounty.
敘廕 is the grant of hereditary protection (yin) privileges, not enfeoffment.
The edict closed. Day jiayin: Zhu Bin was enfeoffed as Earl Who Pacifies the Barbarians and Zhu Tai as Earl Who Pacifies the Border.
Day jiayin: Zhu Bin was enfeoffed as Earl Who Pacifies the Barbarians and Zhu Tai as Earl Who Pacifies the Border.
The Chinese (甲寅，封朱彬為平虜伯…) contains nothing corresponding to "The edict closed."; the phrase is an insertion.
Zhang Ying, vice commander of the Gold Brocade Guard, stabbed himself in remonstrance; guards wrested away the blade and he survived, but after trial he was beaten to death.
Zhang Ying, vice commander of the Jinwu Guard, stabbed himself in remonstrance; guards wrested away the blade and he survived, but after trial he was beaten to death.
金吾衛 is the Jinwu Guard; the "Brocade" guard is the separate 錦衣衛 (Jinyiwei).
Zhang Ying, Vice Commander of the Gold Brocade Guard, cut his own throat to remonstrate; guards seized the blade and he did not die; after trial he was beaten to death.
Zhang Ying, Vice Commander of the Jinwu Guard, cut his own throat to remonstrate; guards seized the blade and he did not die; after trial he was beaten to death.
金吾衛 is the Jinwu Guard; the "Brocade" guard is the separate 錦衣衛 (Jinyiwei).
On yimao, Zhou Xu, director of the Court of Penalties, Yu Tingzan, junior clerk in the Ministry of Rites, Lin Dayu, a principal clerk, and thirty others were sent to Jinyiwei prison.
On yimao, Zhou Xu, director of the Court of Penalties, Yu Tingzan, vice director of the Messenger Office, Lin Dayu, a principal clerk, and thirty others were sent to Jinyiwei prison.
行人司副 is the vice director of the Messenger Office (行人司), not a junior clerk of the Ministry of Rites.
On yimao, Court of Penalties Director Zhou Xu, Ministry of Rites Junior Clerk Yu Tingzan, and Principal Clerk Lin Dayu—thirty-three persons in all—were sent to Jinyiwei prison.
On yimao, Court of Penalties Director Zhou Xu, Messenger Office Vice Director Yu Tingzan, and Principal Clerk Lin Dayu—thirty-three persons in all—were sent to Jinyiwei prison.
行人司副 is the vice director of the Messenger Office (行人司), not a junior clerk of the Ministry of Rites.
On wuwu, Shu Fen and the other one hundred and seven were flogged below the palace gate.
On wuwu, Shu Fen and the others, one hundred and seven in all, were flogged below the palace gate.
舒芬等百有七人 is 107 people including Shu Fen (cf. s0301), not Shu Fen plus 107 others.
On wuwu, Shu Fen and the other one hundred and seven were beaten below the palace gate.
On wuwu, Shu Fen and the others, one hundred and seven in all, were beaten below the palace gate.
舒芬等百有七人 is 107 people including Shu Fen (cf. s0301), not Shu Fen plus 107 others.
In autumn, on jiachen of the seventh month, the Emperor took the field in person against Chenhao; Zhu Tai, Baron of Pacifying the Frontier, was made vice general of martial prestige.
In autumn, on jiachen of the seventh month, the Emperor took the field in person against Chenhao; Zhu Tai, Earl Who Pacifies the Border, was made vice general of martial prestige.
安邊伯: 伯 is an earl, not a baron; the same title is rendered "Earl Who Pacifies the Border" in s0286.
In autumn, the seventh month, on jiachen, the Emperor personally led a campaign against Chenhao; Zhu Tai, Baron of Pacifying the Frontier, was made Vice General of Martial Prestige.
In autumn, the seventh month, on jiachen, the Emperor personally led a campaign against Chenhao; Zhu Tai, Earl Who Pacifies the Border, was made Vice General of Martial Prestige.
安邊伯: 伯 is an earl, not a baron; the same title is rendered "Earl Who Pacifies the Border" in s0286.
On bingwu, Chenhao attacked Anqing; Regional Commander Yang Rui and Prefect Zhang Wenjin drove him back.
On bingwu, Chenhao attacked Anqing; Regional Military Commissioner Yang Rui and Prefect Zhang Wenjin drove him back.
都指揮 is a regional military commissioner (of a Regional Military Commission), not a regional commander (總兵官).
On bingwu, Chenhao attacked Anqing; Regional Commander Yang Rui and Prefect Zhang Wenjin repelled him.
On bingwu, Chenhao attacked Anqing; Regional Military Commissioner Yang Rui and Prefect Zhang Wenjin repelled him.
都指揮 is a regional military commissioner (of a Regional Military Commission), not a regional commander (總兵官).

On guichou, the first day of the third month, there was a solar eclipse.
朔 here is the first day of the third month, not New Year's Day.
In the third month, on guichou, the new year's day; there was a solar eclipse.
In the third month, on guichou, the first day; there was a solar eclipse.
朔 here is the first day of the third month, not New Year's Day.
